items.title: Sweden to buy Lockheed Martin HIMARS in ~$729m deal with Finland sustainment pact
items.title_zh: 瑞典约7.3亿美元采购HIMARS，并与芬兰达成火箭炮维保协作
items.summary_zh: 瑞典国防大臣约松宣布采购约十余套洛克希德·马丁HIMARS及弹药，金额约70亿瑞典克朗（约7.3亿美元），2027年起交付；萨博与洛马意向在瑞典生产PrSM等弹药。芬兰将协助训练维保，坦佩雷欧洲首个HIMARS维保中心承接盟友。北约新成员远程打击能力补齐关键一环。

quotes.author: Pål Jonson / 瑞典国防大臣
quotes.en: This gives the Swedish army a capability it does not have today, the ability to strike at significantly longer distances than today.
quotes.zh: 这赋予瑞典陆军今天所没有的能力：以远超当前的距离实施打击。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.9；据Reuters/Breaking Defense公开报道

items.title: Bill Gates tries to install MovieMaker (2003)
items.title_zh: 比尔·盖茨试图安装 MovieMaker（2003）
items.summary_zh: Techemails 公开 2003 年盖茨安装 MovieMaker 受挫的邮件链，HN 约 342 赞。评论聚焦无人认领责任、热衷组委会的企业文化，以及可用性本该是设计一体而非事后补丁。

quotes.author: 3eb7988a1663
quotes.en: My favorite bit about this is how none of the execs want to take ownership of the change, but instead trying to put someone else in the hot seat and/or start a Committee. This feels like an email that should have been blasted to the entire company. Top-down, empower employees to think of a more unified experience. Then again, all of the external jokes about Microsoft indicate that every department is fighting for their lives against the others, so that kind of kumbaya togetherness was never goin
quotes.zh: 我最喜欢的是没人想对这次改动负责，只想把别人推上火架或另组委员会。这种邮件本该向全公司广播。

quotes.author: bluegatty
quotes.en: They think it's 'some issues' :) :) :) It's a fundamental, cultural and systemic lack of concern for those issues. An 'afterthought' that should be 'integral'. That Gates did not realize that means it's 100% on him. 1000% actually. He was struggling with the language of design and usability in 2003, not even realizing even the implications of what he was seeing (because it would require total rethink). Like a cars coming out of the factory with missing parts ... blame it on the guy on the line?
quotes.zh: 他们觉得只是‘一些问题’ :) 这其实是根本、文化和系统性的漠视。本该是‘一体’的设计事后才想起，盖茨没意识到责任全在他。

items.title: Germany asks ICJ to dismiss Nicaragua case over Israel arms support
items.title_zh: 德国在国际法院请求驳回尼加拉瓜就其对以军援提起的诉讼
items.summary_zh: 海牙国际法院就尼加拉瓜诉德国“通过军援便利加沙种族灭绝”案举行初步反对意见听证。德方律师称尼方未尽责通知、意在把德国拖上法庭；并强调自2024年起未批准可用于加沙冲突的战争武器对以出口。2024年法院曾拒临时禁令但未整案驳回，裁定料年内作出。

quotes.author: Julia Monar / 德国律师
quotes.en: Germany has not, since 2024, authorized an export of weapons of war, with final destination in Israel that can be used in the Gaza conflict.
quotes.zh: 自2024年以来，德国未批准任何最终目的地为以色列、可用于加沙冲突的战争武器出口。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.8；据AP/France24/ICJ公告公开报道

items.title: Switzerland's Federal Government Is Replacing Microsoft on 3k Computers
items.title_zh: 瑞士联邦政府在约三千台电脑上试点替换微软
items.summary_zh: 瑞士联邦试点在约 3000 台电脑上替换微软软件栈，HN 约 335 赞。瑞士网民称仅约 5% 但仍是主权起步；另有观点认为真正风险是用户发现打磨好的 Linux 比 Windows 更舒服。

quotes.author: Atariman
quotes.en: As a Swiss, I'm happy they finally try it. It's only around 5% of all government machines, but at least it's a start and I wish them all the best! We have to get independent asap from the US, they never were our (or any other countries) "friends" and most likely never will be. OSS ftw!
quotes.zh: 作为瑞士人，我高兴他们终于试了。只占政府机约 5%，但至少开了头，祝他们顺利！我们必须尽快摆脱对美国的依赖。

quotes.author: rich_sasha
quotes.en: The real risk to MS here is when people take the plunge and see how much nicer a (well supported, well put together) Linux distro is, compared to Windows etc! Will they want to buy their next laptop at home with MSFT installed? Plus, if countries moving off Microsoft put a fraction of the savings into libre office product development, it might get an even more lopsided comparison!
quotes.zh: 对微软真正的风险是：人们一跳下水就发现（支持得好、拼得好的）Linux 发行版比 Windows 舒服得多！下次家里买笔记本还会装 MSFT 吗？

items.title: Australia plans law letting users switch off social media algorithms
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚拟立法：让用户可关闭社交媒体算法推荐
items.summary_zh: 通讯部长Anika Wells将推动数字注意义务草案，要求平台通过弹窗等机制提供关闭个性化算法、改看关注流的选择，违者面临高额罚款。绿党主张默认关闭；反对党领袖称担心审查。继未成年人社媒禁令后，堪培拉把“算法开关”推成下一监管前沿。

quotes.author: Anika Wells / 澳通讯部长
quotes.en: We want to give Australians more choice over what they see on their social media feeds. Big tech is not a protected species and they should offer their customers basic safety standards.
quotes.zh: 我们希望澳大利亚人对其社媒信息流有更多选择。大型科技公司不是受保护物种，应为用户提供基本安全标准。

items.title: Making a Python interpreter in 1024 bytes
items.title_zh: 用 1024 字节做出一个 Python 解释器
items.summary_zh: 技术博文挑战在 1024 字节内实现 Python 解释器，HN 约 307 赞。讨论指向 Sector C 等“扇区级”黑客技巧，也有人笑称其比最小 C 编译器更脏、几乎不做错误检查。

quotes.author: kristianp
quotes.en: Sector C might have some insights into how to make this even smaller or more featurefull. It has some interesting hacks. https://xorvoid.com/sectorc.html
quotes.zh: Sector C 或许能启发怎么做得更小或更有功能，里面有些有趣的黑客技巧。

quotes.author: jrdres
quotes.en: The code makes me smile, because it's nasty. This isn't like C4, a tiny but complete C compiler which does error checking on its subset. Instead, this is worse than Sector C, which takes every shortcut and just plain assumes everything in the source is right. This "Python" just plain assumes for keywords: Any "f" is a "for [x] in range[y]" (exactly that, no other for's). Any "w" is a "while". Any "i" is an "if". Any "d" is a "def". Any "p" is a "print(" Nasty, nasty. (Also nasty is that the code
quotes.zh: 这段代码让我笑，因为它很脏。不像 C4 那种对子集做错误检查的迷你 C 编译器；它比 Sector C 还糟，假定源码全对。

items.title: China's Supreme People's Court issues AI deepfake and voice-cloning liability rules
items.title_zh: 中国最高法发布AI换脸拟声等纠纷裁判意见
items.summary_zh: 9月7日最高法发布《关于依法审理涉人工智能纠纷案件的意见》（24条），明确未经同意用AI生成可识别虚拟形象或克隆声音侵害人格权/声音权益；用于散布不实言论可构成名誉侵权；平台收通知后未及时采取措施或担责，并覆盖大数据杀熟、人肉搜索等争议。

quotes.author: Xinhua / SPC summary
quotes.en: People cannot use AI to create or distribute recognizable digital replicas of others without their consent, including cloned faces and voices.
quotes.zh: 未经本人同意，不得使用AI创建或传播可识别的数字复制品，包括克隆的人脸与声音。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.7；据新华社/中新网/环球时报公开报道

items.title: Ask HN: How do you manage skills files?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你如何管理 skills 文件？
items.summary_zh: 关于代理 skills 文件管理的 Ask HN 约 290 赞、260 评。主流实践是自写高频可重复技能并 symlink 多代理；反对者称下载网红 skills 多为江湖膏药，好仓库与提示词已够用。

quotes.author: picklenerd
quotes.en: I don’t find skills. I write my own skills based on things I do frequently and repeatably. I keep them version controlled locally and in GitHub, and I symlink that folder to my various agent skill folders so they all stay up to date. I feel like downloading a bunch of skills is another one of those useless collections people make purely because they have infinite options. It’s like those collections of thousands of bookmarks you’re never going to click or pirated ebooks you’re never going to rea
quotes.zh: 我不找 skills，而是按自己常做、可重复的事自己写。本地和 GitHub 版本控制，再 symlink 到各代理的 skill 目录保持同步。感觉下载一堆 skills 是陷阱。

quotes.author: avaer
quotes.en: Skills are mostly snake oil, the way people use them (the aspiration to download kung foo from a celebrity). There was a time when maybe it mattered (last year), but with good repos and good prompts today's agents can find exactly what they need without any skills. "Skills" as developer macros can be useful, but at most those are things shared with the team (in the repo), not something you download from the internet. If you have so many skills that you feel the need to manage them, that's a code
quotes.zh: Skills 大多是江湖膏药——人们指望从网红那里下载功夫。以前或许要紧，但现在好仓库和好提示词就能让代理自己找到所需。

items.title: EU unveils €200m Greenland package as Trump renews control claims
items.title_zh: 欧盟公布2亿欧元格陵兰一揽子投资，正值特朗普再提控制权
items.summary_zh: 欧委会主席冯德莱恩在努克宣布约2亿欧元伙伴关系资金，聚焦连通、清洁能源与关键原材料“三大C”，与格陵兰、丹麦首相同台。表态欧洲与格陵兰“坚定站在一起”，回应特朗普反复主张美方掌控该岛。北约多国同日在格陵兰举行北极军演，地缘竞争与资源布局并行。

quotes.author: Ursula von der Leyen
quotes.en: This partnership package focuses mainly on three domains… connectivity, clean energy and critical raw materials.
quotes.zh: 这份伙伴关系一揽子主要聚焦三个领域：连通性、清洁能源与关键原材料。

items.title: Ask HN: Fable hacked my piano, can I release the results?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：Fable 黑了我的钢琴，结果能公开吗？
items.summary_zh: 用户买自动演奏钢琴后逆向“诱饵音符”限制，询问能否发布工具，HN 约 284 赞。评论提示美国 DMCA 有效技术措施风险与欧洲 DMA 可能豁免，并质疑为自由演奏还需求可的荒谬。

quotes.author: Giefo6ah
quotes.en: If you live in the USA, the "decoy notes" may be considered an "effective technical measure" from the "Digital Millennium Copyright Act". If you live in Europe, this restriction may be considered "gatekeeping" and exempted by the Digital Markets Act. Don't bring attention to yourself by asking for permission. Publish your codec, and if the company cares about this they will send a cease and desist. If you want the world to benefit from your code but you don't want to be responsible for it, try t
quotes.zh: 若在美国，那些‘诱饵音符’可能被视作 DMCA 下的‘有效技术措施’；在欧洲，这种限制或许被 DMA 视为守门人行为而豁免。别主动引起注意。

quotes.author: userbinator
quotes.en: You spent --- what I'd assume would be several k$ from prices found online --- to buy a self-playing piano, and are now asking if you can release the tools to have it play the music of your choosing? IMHO the fact that you even had to think about asking if you could do this is everything that's wrong with society today. IANAL but as long as you aren't releasing something that's copyrighted from the original code, or violating some patent, there shouldn't be anything to worry about. "It's better
quotes.zh: 你花了——网上看大概好几千刀——买自动演奏钢琴，现在还在问能不能发布工具让它弹你想听的曲子？连这个问题都要想一想，本身就说明问题。
